mapper.select: select u.userid as userId, u.small_icon as creatorPhotoUrl, u.nick_name as creatorNickname, a.activity_id as activityId, a.activity_name as name, a.status as status, a.create_date as startDate, a.owner_id as creatorId, g.game_id as gameId, g.name as gameName, g.code as gameCode, g.is_gold as isGold, fg.coins as coins, fg.count as rounds, fg.invite_code as inviteCode, fg.level as level, au.status as isJoin from T_USER u, T_ACTIVITY a, T_FREE_GAME_ACTIVITY fg, T_ACTIVITY_USER au, T_GAME g where au.userid=#{userId} and au.activity_id=a.activity_id and a.activity_id=fg.activity_id and u.userid=a.owner_id and g.game_id=fg.game_id and a.status = 0 and au.status = 1 order by a.create_date desc

select u.small_icon as creatorPhotoUrl, u.nick_name as creatorNickname, a.activity_id as activityId, a.activity_name as name, a.status as status, a.create_date as startDate, a.owner_id as creatorId, g.game_id as gameId, g.name as gameName, g.code as gameCode, fg.coins as coins, fg.count as rounds, fg.invite_code as inviteCode, fg.level as level from T_USER u, T_ACTIVITY a, T_FREE_GAME_ACTIVITY fg, T_GAME g where au.userid=#{userId} and a.activity_id=fg.activity_id and u.userid=a.owner_id and a.owner_id = #{userId} and g.game_id=fg.game_id and a.status = 0 order by a.create_date desc

select fg.activity_id as gameActivityId, a.activity_name as activityName, fg.invite_code as inviteCode, fg.coins as coins, fg.minutes as minutes, fg.level as level, a.status as status, a.start_date as startDate, fg.game_id as gameId, g.name as gameName, g.photo as gamePhoto, g.code as gameCode, a.owner_id as creatorId, u.nick_name as creatorNickname, u.small_icon as creatorPhotoUrl, fg.chatroom_id as chatRoomId, fg.table_id as tableId from t_free_game_activity fg, t_activity a, t_game g, t_user u where fg.invite_code=#{inviteCode} and fg.activity_id=a.activity_id and a.status!=2 and fg.game_id=g.game_id and a.owner_id=u.userid
SELECT fg.game_id FROM t_free_game_activity fg, t_activity a WHERE fg.activity_id = a.activity_id AND a.`status` = 0 AND invite_code = #{inviteCode}

select fg.activity_id as gameActivityId, a.activity_name as activityName, fg.invite_code as inviteCode, fg.coins as coins, fg.minutes as minutes, fg.level as level, a.status as status, a.start_date as startDate, fg.game_id as gameId, a.owner_id as creatorId, fg.chatroom_id as chatRoomId, fg.table_id as tableId from t_free_game_activity fg, t_activity a where a.level=#{level} and fg.activity_id=a.activity_id and a.status!=2

select fg.activity_id as gameActivityId, a.activity_name as activityName, fg.invite_code as inviteCode, fg.coins as coins, fg.minutes as minutes, fg.level as level, a.status as status, a.start_date as startDate, fg.game_id as gameId, a.owner_id as creatorId, fg.chatroom_id as chatRoomId, fg.table_id as tableId from t_free_game_activity fg, t_activity a where fg.activity_id=a.activity_id and a.status!=2

select v.*,u.userid as userId, u.small_icon as photo, u.nick_name as nickname from (select a.cards as cards, a.discription as discription, a.activity_id as activityId, a.activity_name as name, a.status as status, a.create_date as startDate, a.owner_id as creatorId, g.game_id as gameId, g.name as gameName, g.code as gameCode, fg.coins as coins, fg.count as rounds, fg.invite_code as inviteCode, fg.level as level
from T_ACTIVITY a, T_FREE_GAME_ACTIVITY fg, T_GAME g where a.owner_id=#{userId} and a.activity_id=fg.activity_id and g.game_id=fg.game_id and g.is_gold != 1 and room_type=#{roomType} and a.status = 0 order by a.create_date desc) v LEFT JOIN `t_activity_user` au on v.activityId = au.`activity_id` LEFT JOIN `t_user` u on u.`userid` = au.`userid`

SELECT activity_id as mapKey, round_index as mapValue FROM player_round_activityid${l} where player_id=#{userId} and type=1 order by create_time desc , round_index desc limit #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}

SELECT tfgr.id as id, tfgr.activity_id as activityId, tfgr.content as content, tfgr.level as level, tfgr.round_index as roundIndex , tfgr.end_time as endTime, tfgr.replay_url as replayUrl from player_round_activityid${l} pra4 ,t_free_game_round tfgr WHERE pra4.activity_id=tfgr.activity_id and pra4.round_index=tfgr.round_index and tfgr.level=#{level} and pra4.player_id=#{userId} order by pra4.create_time DESC limit #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}
SELECT activity_id as mapKey, round_index as mapValue FROM player_result_activityid${l} where player_id=#{userId} and type=2 order by create_time desc limit #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}
SELECT content as content, round_index as roundIndex, end_time as endTime, replay_url as replayUrl FROM t_free_game_round where activity_id=#{mapKey} and round_index=#{mapValue}
SELECT activity_id as activityId, content as content, end_Date as endDate FROM t_free_game_result where activity_id=#{mapKey} limit 1
SELECT content as content, round_index as roundIndex, end_time as endTime, replay_url as replayUrl, level as level FROM t_free_game_round where activity_id=#{activityId} order by round_index

SELECT tfgr.content as content, tfgr.round_index as roundIndex, tfgr.end_time as endTime, tfgr.replay_url as replayUrl FROM player_round_activityid${l} pra LEFT JOIN t_free_game_round tfgr ON pra.activity_id=tfgr.activity_id and pra.round_index=tfgr.round_index WHERE pra.player_id =#{userId} and pra.type=1 order by pra.create_time desc , pra.round_index desc LIMIT #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}
